conventions.convention: Simplex spaces use total degree; affine tensor-box spaces use degree at most p in each reference coordinate. Conformity requires equality of polynomial traces, with shared-face degree equal to the minimum of the incident cell degrees. Curved cells are excluded.
The integrated projector has p ≥ 1, projects the derivative onto degree p−1, and anchors the primitive at the left endpoint.
The weighted simplex spectral scale is defined by orthogonal degree-layer coefficients; it is not identified with ordinary unweighted Sobolev spaces.

The varying-degree triangle estimate uses m_K, the minimum of all incident edge degrees, including neighboring restrictions. Its factorial rate requires integer r ≥ 5 and m_K ≥ 2r−4; constants have no asserted useful growth bound in r.

GLL weights are integrals of cardinal polynomials at endpoints and roots of P_p′. Transport uses the absolute affine Jacobian. Sampled coefficients must have specified pointwise values, including boundary nodes.
Corner weights satisfy 0 ≤ β_i < 1, and the pointwise decay exponent satisfies 0 < a < min_i(1−β_i). Derivative weights are the product of corner distances raised to β_i+j−2.

The corner theorem assumes O(k) matching shape-regular triangles, geometrically shrinking corner caps, and uniform total degree proportional to k. Zero boundary values are imposed only on the fixed polygon-edge set Γ_D.
Ordinary Sobolev triangle approximation and interpolation assume full Choice. The weighted corner and fixed-box analytic branches assume Countable Choice.
The SIPDG witness uses jump v(0−)−v(0+), the arithmetic average derivative, natural exterior boundary conditions, and unit cell sizes.

load_bearing.statement: For endpoint-zero polynomial q, Lq(x,y)=q(x)−xR(1−y), where R(t)=q(t)/t, preserves degree, has trace q on one edge and zero on the other two, and satisfies ||Lq||_{H1(T)} ≤ 4||q′||_{L2(0,1)} independently of degree.

Under the stated weighted factorial bounds and Countable Choice, u has a unique continuous representative, corner decay |u(x)−u(c_i)| ≤ Cr^a, derivative bounds CA^{|α|}|α|!r^{a−|α|}, uniform scaled analytic bounds on regular triangles, and cap affine-interpolation errors Ch^a in H1 seminorm and Ch^{a+1} in L2.

Under full Choice, continuous cellwise H2 data on a matching shape-regular triangle mesh admit a linear trace-matching interpolant preserving zero boundary edges, with the stated degree-independent local comparison estimates for every q ∈ P_{m_K}(K), and the stated factorial rate under r ≥ 5 and m_K ≥ 2r−4.

Under Choice, for integer r ≥ 5 and p ≥ 2r−4, a bounded linear map A_{p,r}:H^r(T)→P_p(T) satisfies ||u−A_{p,r}u||_{H2(T)} ≤ C_r sqrt((n−r+3)!/(n+r−5)!) |u|_{Hr(T)}, where n=floor(p/2), with the stated affine scaled estimate.

Smooth functions on the closed reference triangle or interval satisfying ||D^αf||∞ ≤ MA^{|α|}|α|! admit polynomial W^{1,∞} approximation bounded by CMe^{−bp}. The interval branch also has an endpoint-preserving derivative-projection polynomial with exponential H1 error.

For p ≥ 1, GLL quadrature is positive and exact through degree 2p−1; its squared-norm defect is 2(p+1)/(p(2p+1)) times the squared top Legendre coefficient. Tensor mass and gradient squared norms lie between their exact values and 3^d times those values, including affine boxes.

Under Countable Choice and the uniform reference derivative bound M|ν|!R^{−|ν|}, R>1, tensorized integrated Legendre projection on a fixed matching affine tensor mesh has matching traces and H1 error at most C M q^p for R^{−1}<q<1.
Under Choice, for integer k ≥ 1, N ≥ k−1 and f ∈ H^k(−1,1), ||f−Π_Nf||2 ≤ sqrt((N+1−k)!/(N+1+k)!) ||f^{(k)}||2.

Under Countable Choice, matching polynomial traces on a finite matching affine simplicial or face-to-face affine tensor-box mesh give an H1 function whose weak gradient is the cellwise polynomial gradient.
